```flowproof
workflow author_critic
  needs task: text
  role author can edit
  role critic can answer
  budget at most 5 calls

  var current = edit author: "{task}"
  var approved = false

  repeat at most 2 until approved
    set approved = ask critic: """
      Is the latest change acceptable for this task?
      Task: {task}
      Latest change:
      {current.patch}
      Answer yes or no.
      """ as bool
    if not approved
      set current = edit author: """
        Revise the latest change to address the task.
        Task: {task}
        Previous change:
        {current.patch}
        The critic did not approve it.
        """
    end
  end

  give current
end
```
